sentences.l2: 很久以前，人们想写音乐。

sentences.l2: 他们画符号，表示声音高低。

sentences.l2: 学生练习，记住符号的意思。
sentences.l1: Students practiced and remembered the meanings of the symbols.

sentences.l2: 时间很久，记谱法变简单了。
sentences.l1: Over a long time, musical notation became simpler.
